thread:
jen-cs: FYI CedarPoint reporting sudden p99 spikes on embeds API since 08:12 UTC, only affects tenant `cedarpoint-prod` and a tiny fraction of keys. Customer is seeing ~12–18s p99. They're on Dedicated but not reserved for this shard. :worried:

miguel-eng: thx — do we have an example request id or sample payload? any size/payload pattern?

jen-cs: pasted two request ids they sent: `req_8a9f2` and `req_b3d41`. Looks like both are embedding bulk jobs with many short texts (len 16–64). Not every request slow, maybe a hotkey.

ash-sre: pulled infra traces — these requests hit the same GPU shard and show long queue time before start_kv_lookup. KV cache miss rate very low but there's a single key with extremely heavy writes. suspect prefix hotkey + cache eviction noise. trace snippet:

```
queue_ms: 12750
start_kv_lookup_ms: 12758
kv_lookup_ms: 2
start_infer_ms: 12760
infer_ms: 80
```

ash-sre: queue waiting ~12.7s, infer itself quick. Looks like tenant-level queuing/backpressure, not model slowdown.

lina-ops: CedarPoint asked for an allowlist/reservation to avoid throttling. They want temporary burst capacity for next 6 hours while they throttle upstream. Can we do a quick reservation + soft-priority?

kate-eng: we have two mitigations: 1) add cedarpoint-prod to priority reservation for shard-7 (adds 50% extra slots) 2) apply per-tenant per-key rate limiting on hotkey pattern to smooth spikes. Reservation is quickest.

miguel-eng: agree. Also recommend a short-term KV hotkey patch: detect top-10 heavy keys in tenant cache and apply per-key qps cap (configurable). That avoids single-key queueing. I can ship a small config change to runtime.

jen-cs: customer would prefer immediate fix — asked that we "whitelist" them so their jobs are not throttled. Can we do reservation now and the runtime patch next 2 hours?

ash-sre: I'm preparing a shard-level reservation change. Risk is transient resource churn for other tenants on shard-7. I'll coordinate with oncall-bot.

oncall-bot: Reservation request accepted by infra. Applied soft-reservation: shard-7 -> +50% capacity for tenant cedarpoint-prod for 6h. Logged: infra/reservations/cedarpoint/2876501234

jen-cs: passing to customer — they confirm p99 dropped to ~550ms on first sample after reservation. :relieved:

miguel-eng: starting hotkey cap rollout to runtime (feature flag: hotkey-cap-tenant) — will push canary to two nodes in shard-7. If we see regressions I'll roll back.

ash-sre: monitoring now. Added alert to SLO dashboard for p99 cross-tenant drift. Also setting temporary allowlist record for this tenant to avoid auto-throttle tuning.

lina-ops: marked support ticket with reservation id and ETA for runtime fix. Will request formal reservation process for next maintenance window if they want longer term.

kate-eng: follow-ups: (1) migration doc for customers on how to avoid hotkeys in bulk embedding jobs, (2) runtime hotkey-cap validated and rolled to stable in 2h, (3) consider tenant reservation product flow for predictable bursts.

jen-cs: cedarpoint happy for now, asked for postmortem and guidance. I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow with them. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
